title: MLOps Engineer

nodes.title: Software Engineering Best Practices for ML Systems
nodes.subtitle: Modular Python packaging, virtual environments, unit tests for data/models, type hints, linting
learning_objectives: Refactor notebook research code into modular, importable Python packages with type hints
Write unit tests for feature transformation functions and data validation
feynman_prompts: Why is shipping Jupyter notebooks directly to production an engineering anti-pattern?
key_misconceptions: Deploying untyped, untested notebook code with hardcoded local file paths directly to servers

nodes.title: Data & Pipeline Versioning with DVC
nodes.subtitle: Data Version Control (DVC), tracking large files on S3/GCS, .dvc files, reproducible pipelines
learning_objectives: Version multi-gigabyte training datasets alongside code commits using Git and DVC
Configure remote cloud storage backends (S3, GCS) for centralized team dataset synchronization
feynman_prompts: How does DVC track multi-gigabyte data files in Git repositories without bloating Git storage?
key_misconceptions: Committing raw multi-gigabyte training datasets directly into Git repositories

nodes.title: Experiment Tracking & Model Registry with MLflow
nodes.subtitle: Logging parameters, metrics, artifacts, MLflow Tracking Server, Model Registry lifecycle
learning_objectives: Log metrics, hyperparameters, and confusion matrix artifacts automatically during training runs
Manage model lifecycles through Staging, Production, and Archived states in the Model Registry
feynman_prompts: Why is a centralized Model Registry essential for tracking provenance and governing production releases?
key_misconceptions: Saving model weights as unversioned local pickle files on developer laptops

nodes.title: Feature Stores: Feast Architecture & Point-in-Time Joins
nodes.subtitle: Online vs offline feature stores, point-in-time correct joins, feature definitions, preventing leakage
learning_objectives: Deploy and manage an open-source feature store using Feast
Execute point-in-time correct historical joins to eliminate feature leakage in training sets
feynman_prompts: What is train-serve skew and how do feature stores guarantee parity between training and inference features?
key_misconceptions: Re-implementing feature engineering in SQL for training and Python for serving, introducing logic mismatch

nodes.title: Containerization for Machine Learning & CUDA Support
nodes.subtitle: Multi-stage Dockerfiles for ML, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, CUDA base images, non-root users
learning_objectives: Build lightweight, reproducible container images with CUDA GPU acceleration support
Ensure consistent runtime execution across local workstations and cloud training clusters
feynman_prompts: Why must the NVIDIA Container Toolkit be installed on the host to expose GPUs inside Docker containers?
key_misconceptions: Building monolithic 15GB Docker images containing unnecessary build compilers and debug packages

nodes.title: ML Pipeline Orchestration: Kubeflow & Airflow
nodes.subtitle: Containerized pipeline steps, Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP), components, DAG execution, caching
learning_objectives: Author scalable, reusable ML training pipelines using Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP)
Configure pipeline task caching so unchanged data preparation steps are not re-executed
feynman_prompts: Why are containerized pipeline components superior to running monolithic scripts on a single VM?
key_misconceptions: Re-running expensive 10-hour data preprocessing steps every time a minor model hyperparameter changes

nodes.title: Automated Model Validation & Quality Gates
nodes.subtitle: Data schema validation, model regression tests, fairness & bias checks, performance thresholds
learning_objectives: Implement automated CI quality gates that block deployment if challenger accuracy is lower than champion
Test models for algorithmic bias and demographic performance disparities before release
feynman_prompts: Why must automated model regression testing run before promoting a candidate model in the registry?
key_misconceptions: Deploying newly trained models directly to production without verifying performance against benchmark test sets

nodes.title: CI/CD & Continuous Training (CT) Pipelines
nodes.subtitle: GitHub Actions for ML, automated training on data updates, automated model packaging, release gates
learning_objectives: Build automated CI/CD pipelines that trigger model training when new verified data is ingested
Automate container image publishing and Model Registry updates via GitHub Actions
feynman_prompts: What is Continuous Training (CT) in MLOps and how does it extend traditional CI/CD?
key_misconceptions: Triggering manual multi-day retraining workflows ad-hoc only after users complain about degradation

nodes.title: Model Packaging & Optimization with ONNX Runtime
nodes.subtitle: ONNX export, graph optimization, ONNX Runtime execution providers (CPU, CUDA, TensorRT)
learning_objectives: Export PyTorch and Scikit-Learn models to standardized ONNX representation
Benchmark inference latency and optimize compute graphs using ONNX Runtime
feynman_prompts: Why does the ONNX format decouple model training frameworks from inference serving platforms?
key_misconceptions: Deploying full PyTorch training environments to production servers just to run forward inference

nodes.title: Production Model Serving: Triton & TorchServe
nodes.subtitle: Triton Inference Server, dynamic batching, multi-model concurrency, model repository
learning_objectives: Deploy enterprise model serving infrastructure using NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
Configure dynamic batching to maximize GPU utilization under high-throughput concurrent requests
feynman_prompts: How does dynamic batching in Triton aggregate individual incoming requests into a single GPU tensor batch?
key_misconceptions: Serving models with single-threaded Flask applications that handle one request at a time

nodes.title: Real-Time Inference APIs with FastAPI & gRPC
nodes.subtitle: FastAPI endpoints, gRPC Protocol Buffers, request validation with Pydantic, health checks
learning_objectives: Build high-performance REST and gRPC inference microservices with strict schema validation
Implement readiness and liveness health checks that monitor model loading state
feynman_prompts: Why is gRPC preferred over REST/JSON for low-latency internal microservice model inference?
key_misconceptions: Failing to implement readiness probes, routing live user traffic to servers before models finish loading into RAM

nodes.title: Continuous Monitoring: Data Drift & Concept Drift
nodes.subtitle: Evidently AI, Evidently dashboards, Drift metrics (KS test, Wasserstein distance, PSI), alerting
learning_objectives: Detect statistical distribution changes in production feature inputs using Evidently AI
Configure automated Slack / PagerDuty alerts when population stability index (PSI) exceeds thresholds
feynman_prompts: How does data drift detection warn engineers of model degradation before ground-truth labels are available?
key_misconceptions: Assuming models maintain their benchmark accuracy indefinitely without monitoring live production distributions

nodes.title: Production Model Observability & Explainability
nodes.subtitle: Logging inference payloads, Prometheus latency metrics, OpenTelemetry, on-demand SHAP explanations
learning_objectives: Instrument production inference servers with Prometheus metrics (p99 latency, throughput, error rates)
Log production predictions and calculate on-demand SHAP explanations for audited decisions
feynman_prompts: Why is logging raw prediction inputs and outputs essential for post-incident model debugging?
key_misconceptions: Discarding live inference payloads, making it impossible to diagnose why a model made a disastrous prediction

nodes.title: Automated Retraining & Active Learning Loops
nodes.subtitle: Drift-triggered retraining pipelines, active learning sample selection, human-in-the-loop annotation
learning_objectives: Trigger automated Kubeflow retraining pipelines when monitored drift metrics exceed critical levels
Select low-confidence production samples for priority human re-annotation (Active Learning)
feynman_prompts: How does active learning minimize data annotation costs by only labeling samples with high model uncertainty?
key_misconceptions: Blindly retraining models on uncurated live production outputs without quality filtering

nodes.title: Deployment Strategies: Shadow & Canary Deployments
nodes.subtitle: Shadow traffic mirroring, canary rollouts, blue/green deployments, A/B testing live model variants
learning_objectives: Mirror real production traffic to a new challenger model in shadow mode with zero user impact
Execute progressive canary rollouts (1% -> 10% -> 100%) with automated rollbacks on error spikes
feynman_prompts: Why is shadow traffic deployment the safest way to evaluate latency and stability before going live?
key_misconceptions: Switching 100% of production traffic to a newly trained model instantly without canary verification

nodes.title: Infrastructure FinOps & GPU Cluster Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Cloud GPU cost management, spot/preemptible instances, KEDA event-driven autoscaling
learning_objectives: Scale GPU inference clusters dynamically based on queue depth using KEDA
Execute distributed batch training jobs on discounted cloud spot instances with checkpointing
feynman_prompts: How does checkpointing enable fault-tolerant distributed training on preemptible spot instances?
key_misconceptions: Keeping expensive multi-GPU training instances running 24/7 after training jobs complete

nodes.title: Model Governance, Security & Lineage Auditing
nodes.subtitle: Model Cards, cryptographic artifact hashes, model inversion attack defense, compliance audits
learning_objectives: Generate comprehensive Model Cards documenting performance, intended use, and limitations
Protect model weights against theft and audit end-to-end lineage from raw data to deployed binary
feynman_prompts: Why are standardized Model Cards essential for regulatory compliance (e.g. EU AI Act)?
key_misconceptions: Deploying proprietary models without cryptographic checksum verification, risking tampering

nodes.title: Edge AI & Embedded Deployment (TensorRT / TFLite)
nodes.subtitle: TensorRT, TensorFlow Lite, CoreML, quantization (FP16/INT8), edge hardware constraints
learning_objectives: Optimize and compile deep neural networks for edge execution using NVIDIA TensorRT
Deploy lightweight models to mobile and IoT devices under strict memory and thermal constraints
feynman_prompts: How does TensorRT layer fusion reduce memory bandwidth bottlenecks during edge inference?
key_misconceptions: Deploying un-quantized desktop deep learning models to low-power mobile devices, draining battery life

description: Master MLOps Engineer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
